title: When trying again still cannot open the conversation

steps.path: Resume Session → Try again → another refusal
steps.headline: A second refusal now asks whether to take over.
steps.changed: Instead of repeating Try again, the second refusal opens the existing takeover confirmation. This replaces R-2's endless retry behavior, as you requested.
steps.notice: Take over requests the handoff; Never mind opens nothing. If the handoff cannot be confirmed, proceeding still needs a separate confirmation.
steps.risk: These are real renderer screens with simulated computers, not proof of cross-device transfer. Before uses the previous review's denial capture; After was reached by clicking Try again in the updated flow.
